description: Free (rate-limited, 100 a day). Pass a public wallet address (Base 0x..., XRP Ledger r... or Stellar G...) to list the x402 sellers that wallet paid in the last 90 days, each with the same plain summary line as lumi_trust_check (how many times Lumi test-bought it and how many delivered, or that Lumi has not test-bought it yet) and simple flags (listing looks dead, no longer listed, recent checks failed, repeat or possible duplicate payments). Base reads Lumi's index of public USDC transfers into CDP Bazaar payTos; XRPL and Stellar read the latest 200 ledger entries. Public data only; Lumi does not store the address. No price comparisons. Observations, not a guarantee.

address.description: A public wallet address: Base 0x..., XRP Ledger r... or Stellar G...
